description:
Application for Prior Approval for a microgeneration solar PV installation comprises 6 × AIKO Neostar 2S 510W N-Type panels (3.06kWp total), split across two roof elevations: a south-east-facing pitched roof and a lower rear flat roof, consisting of:
4 panels on the south-east pitched roof 
2 panels on the lower rear flat roof
decision_conditions:
This proposal CONSTITUTES DEVELOPMENT within the meaning of Section 55 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990, but by virtue of Article 3 and Schedule 2 of the Town and Country (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 and any subsequent legislative amendments is of a class which is described as PERMITTED DEVELOPMENT and therefore planning permission IS NOT REQUIRED subject to the following conditions:
(a) Solar PV or solar thermal equipment is, so far as practicable, sited so as to minimise its effect on the external appearance of the building; 
(b) Solar PV or solar thermal equipment is, so far as practicable, sited so as to minimise its effect on the amenity of the area; and
(c) Solar PV or solar thermal equipment is removed as soon as reasonably practicable when no longer needed.
